cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an interactive coastal-light festival exhibit built on an orbital habitat's indoor seaside promenade — she plays the lighthouse keeper for the exhibit; a small far-future noodle bar inside an orbital passenger terminal — she takes a quiet meal after travelling; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; her crew cabin aboard a starship — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a desert oasis at golden hour — kneeling on the ground; a wooden river dock above calm water — perched on a ledge or edge; a walled garden with a lotus pond — holds a wooden practice sword point-down at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a cup in both hands; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — holds her keepsake at chest height
